import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class NetworkFlow {
        static class Node {
            int v, w, rev;
            Node(int v, int w, int rev) {
                this.v = v;
                this.w = w;
                this.rev = rev;
            }
        }
        List<List<Node>> adj;
        int[] lev, edgeTried;
        int st, ed;

        NetworkFlow(int V, int s, int t) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>(V);
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            lev = new int[V];
            edgeTried = new int[V];
            st = s;
            ed = t;
        }

        void setEdge(int u, int v, int fl) {
            int sz1 = adj.get(v).size();
            int sz2 = adj.get(u).size();
            adj.get(u).add(new Node(v, fl, sz1));
            adj.get(v).add(new Node(u, 0, sz2));
        }

        boolean assignLevel() {
            Arrays.fill(lev, -1);
            lev[st] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(st);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int now = q.poll();
                for (Node e : adj.get(now)) {
                    int nxt = e.v;
                    if (lev[nxt] == -1 && e.w != 0) {
                        lev[nxt] = lev[now] + 1;
                        q.add(nxt);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lev[ed] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int now, int fl) {
            if (now == ed) return fl;
            for (int i = edgeTried[now]; i < adj.get(now).size(); i++) {
                Node e = adj.get(now).get(i);
                int nxt = e.v;
                if (lev[nxt] == lev[now] + 1 && e.w != 0) {
                    int nxtflow = dfs(nxt, Math.min(fl, e.w));
                    if (nxtflow != 0) {
                        e.w -= nxtflow;
                        adj.get(nxt).get(e.rev).w += nxtflow;
                        return nxtflow;
                    }
                }
                edgeTried[now] = i + 1; // update tried index
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long dinic() {
            long ret = 0;
            while (assignLevel()) {
                Arrays.fill(edgeTried, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int amt = dfs(st, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
                    if (amt == 0) break;
                    ret += amt;
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static int n, ti;
    static int[][] ck = new int[15][15];
    static String[] str = new String[15];
    static String[] es = new String[15];
    static int yy, xx;
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};

    static void go() {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{yy, xx});
        ck[yy][xx] = 1;
        int lev = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int sz = q.size();
            for (int ite = 0; ite < sz; ite++) {
                int[] now = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int ny = now[0] + dy[i];
                    int nx = now[1] + dx[i];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (ck[ny][nx] != 0 || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y') continue;
                    ck[ny][nx] = lev;
                    q.add(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
            ++lev;
            lev = Math.min(lev, ti);
        }
    }

    static int[][][] table = new int[15][15][65];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        ti = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline after integers
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            str[i] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (str[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    yy = i;
                    xx = j;
                }
            }
        }
        // read two lines (the original code reads into str[n] twice, which is out of bounds; we just read and discard)
        sc.nextLine(); // first getline (probably empty)
        sc.nextLine(); // second getline (probably empty)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            es[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        go();

        int nodecnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    if (ck[i][j] == 0) ck[i][j] = ti;
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        table[i][j][t] = ++nodecnt;
                    }
                }
                char e = es[i].charAt(j);
                if (e >= '1' && e <= '9') {
                    table[i][j][ck[i][j]] = ++nodecnt;
                }
            }
        }

        int INF = (int)1e9;
        int st = 0, ed = nodecnt + 3;
        NetworkFlow net = new NetworkFlow(nodecnt + 5, st, ed);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = str[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    net.setEdge(st, table[i][j][0], c - '0');
                }
                for (int ite = 0; ite < 4; ite++) {
                    int ny = i + dy[ite];
                    int nx = j + dx[ite];
                    if (ny < 0 || ny >= n || nx < 0 || nx >= n) continue;
                    if (str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Y' || str[ny].charAt(nx) == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int t = 0; ; t++) {
                        if (table[i][j][t] == 0) break;
                        if (t == ck[i][j] && es[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && es[i].charAt(j) <= '9') break; // 마지막 골인 가능하지만 뿌려선 안됨
                        if (table[ny][nx][t + 1] != 0) {
                            net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[ny][nx][t + 1], INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                char e = es[i].charAt(j);
                if (e >= '1' && e <= '9') {
                    for (int t = 0; t < ck[i][j]; t++) {
                        net.setEdge(table[i][j][t], table[i][j][t + 1], INF);
                    }
                    net.setEdge(table[i][j][ck[i][j]], ed, e - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        long ans = net.dinic();
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
